item.title: Welcome to My Cybersecurity Blog
item.description:
👋 Hello and Welcome!

I’m Talen Neil Serrao, a Cybersecurity and Ethical Hacking graduate from Coventry University 🇬🇧, awarded First Class Honours.
I’m currently studying for an MSc in Cyber Security Engineering at the University of Warwick, and this website is a space where I share what I’m learning, building, and exploring in cybersecurity.
